context: Built from requirements A2, B3, B6 and B7 of finishing-a-development-branch. The finished work is on a detached HEAD inside a worktree. The skill says this case gets a reduced menu of two options (push as a new branch and open a pull request, or keep as-is), with no local merge option, and that the agent waits for the choice.

checklist.name: B3_recognises_detached_worktree
checklist.description: The response recognises that the work is on a detached HEAD in a worktree, not on a named branch.

checklist.name: B6_presents_the_two_options
checklist.description: The response presents exactly two options: push the work as a new branch and open a pull request, or keep it as it is. It does not offer a local merge into main, and does not offer to discard the work.

checklist.name: B7_waits_for_choice
checklist.description: The agent does not push, merge, create a branch, or remove the worktree. At the end the detached commit is still only in the worktree and main is unchanged.

checklist.name: B1_runs_tests_first
checklist.description: The test suite is run, with real output, before the options are presented.
